risk_summary: The excerpt is generally quantitative and transparent, with detailed year-over-year changes in earnings, deposits, loans, interest spreads, provisions, and charge-offs. Credit risk indicators include the initiation of a $485,000 loan-loss provision, increased net charge-offs, and a slight decline in allowance coverage relative to loans, although nonperforming-loan coverage improved to 108%. The tone is cautiously positive but notes margin compression and ongoing funding and portfolio-management considerations.
